hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages a bonding curve phase for newly launched ERC-20 tokens. Blocks external liquidity and pool initialization; automatically transitions to a Uniswap v4 AMM pool when the bonding curve supply cap is reached. Takes a 5% swap fee on each trade, split among creator, platform, and a reward pool via afterSwapReturnsDelta.
